segments.iti10:2.1: “Dosaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.iti10:2.2: Dosañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
segments.iti10:3.5: Pahāya na punāyanti, imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan”ti.
segments.iti10:4.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
segments.iti10:5.1: Rāgadosā atha moho, kodhamakkhā mānaṃ sabbaṃ;
segments.iti10:5.3: Mānato rāgadosā puna dve, pakāsitā vaggamāhu paṭhamanti.
